colors.primary.lastReason: Ensure >= 4.5:1 AA contrast on primary CTA

insights.text: Moving the 290px Navigation Sidebar to the Right-Hand Side via .home-sidebar-layout { flex-direction: row-reverse !important; } while anchoring #oi-cli-dock-root at bottom-left (left: 20px; bottom: 20px) preserves 100% of SvelteKit 5 behavior with zero footer overlap.

Structuring design/ontology.tokens.json into 3 tiers (primitive-* -> semantic-* -> composite-*) and sealing 76 tokens in design/design.tokens.json guarantees 100% WCAG AA contrast across all 15 text x surface pairs and 24 components.
